items.title: Robinhood Plans 2027 UAE Launch With Dubai Retail License
items.summary: The DFSA register lists Robinhood MENA Limited’s license from July 20, including permission to arrange crypto deals and custody for retail clients.

items.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
SoFi Launches SOFIE Tokenized Deposit With 4.4% APY
items.summary: Members can convert the deposit into SoFiUSD at a 1:1 rate, but deposit interest and FDIC coverage do not follow the money into the stablecoin.
